map.由资产与负债求净资产 使用指南: Net worth from assets and liabilities guide
map.输入各项总资产与总负债，计算个人与家庭的净资产（总资产−总负债），用于财务状况盘: Enter all assets and liabilities to compute personal and household net worth (total assets - total liabilities), for financial inventory and asset allocation review.
map.净资产=总资产−总负债，含房产、存款、投资与房贷、信用贷等。自住房计入资产但流动: Net worth = total assets - total liabilities, including property, deposits, investments as well as mortgages, credit loans and so on. Owner-occupied housing counts as an asset but has poor liquidity, so an "investable net worth" figure is often listed separately when analyzing solvency.
map.家庭财务盘点时核算真实财富水位。: Compute the true wealth level during a household financial inventory.
map.申请大额授信时证明资产实力。: Demonstrate financial strength when applying for large credit facilities.
map.资产 500 万、负债 200 万的净资产: Net worth with assets of 5,000,000 and liabilities of 2,000,000
map.：净资产=总资产−总负债=500−200=300 万。若含自住房但负债多为房贷，: : net worth = total assets - total liabilities = 5,000,000 - 2,000,000 = 3,000,000. If an owner-occupied home is included while liabilities are mostly a mortgage, distinguish "net worth" from "investable net worth".
map.由实际年化利率与复利频率求名义利率: Nominal rate from effective annual rate and compounding frequency
map.由每期现金流与贴现率求永续年金现值: Compute the perpetuity present value from periodic cash flow and discount rate
map.由每期付款、利率与期数求期初年金现值: Compute the annuity-due present value from payment, rate and number of periods
map.自住房算资产吗？: Does an owner-occupied home count as an asset?
map.算。净资产=所有资产（含房产、存款、投资）减所有负债（房贷、车贷、信用贷）。但自: Yes. Net worth = all assets (including property, deposits and investments) minus all liabilities (mortgage, car loan, credit loans). But owner-occupied housing has poor liquidity, so an "investable net worth" figure is often listed separately when analyzing solvency.
map.能。当负债超过资产（如房价大跌且高杠杆）即为负净资产，俗称「资不抵债」，需警惕流: Yes. When liabilities exceed assets (for instance after a housing price crash with high leverage) net worth is negative, commonly called being "underwater"; beware of liquidity and default risk.
